layout.arrangement: Thin red frame borders the whole slide. A light-gray title bar spans the top with a centered red title and a yellow '44' badge at its right end. Below and top-left sits a blue bold italic two-line header. The middle band contains four isometric 3D voxel-block diagrams left-to-right: input tensor (far left), Group Normalization cube (center-left), Instance Normalization cube (center-right), and a dimension-labeled tensor enclosed in a thin red rectangle (far right). Two bordered text boxes sit under the middle cubes (Group Normalization left, Instance Normalization right), and a full-width bordered text box for Layer Normalization runs along the bottom, with a black 'Transformer choice' oval overlapping its right end.

visual_elements.description: Input tensor: isometric 3D block of small cubes. Front face ~4 columns x 5 rows of salmon/coral cells. Top face: receding banded rows of green, yellow, orange. Right side face: vertical strips of yellow, orange, blue-gray. Red double-headed arrow along the upper-left depth edge labeled 'Samples' (text rotated along arrow); red double-headed horizontal arrow beneath the front face labeled 'Channels'. A small white mouse-cursor arrow rests on the front face (~11% x, ~55% y).

Group Normalization illustration: isometric voxel block. Front face: left ~three-quarters magenta/purple cells, right ~quarter orange/salmon cells (two highlighted channel groups). Top face: banded rows dark navy-blue (back), green, yellow, orange (front). Right side face: vertical strips yellow, orange, blue-gray. No arrows or labels; pairs with the 'Group Normalization' text box below.

Instance Normalization illustration: isometric voxel block. Front face: magenta/purple cells with a single orange column at the right edge (one channel highlighted). Top face: banded rows dark navy-blue, green, yellow, orange. Right side face: yellow/orange strips. Pairs with the 'Instance Normalization' text box below.

Dimension-labeled tensor enclosed in a thin red rectangle (highlight container ~66-95% x, ~15-70% y). Isometric voxel block: front face ~4x5 magenta/purple cells; top face banded rows green, yellow, orange; right side face vertical strips yellow, orange, blue-gray. Three red double-headed arrows with labels: vertical arrow at left labeled 'Feature Vector' (text rotated 90°, reading upward); horizontal arrow under the front face labeled 'Channels'; diagonal arrow along the right depth edge labeled 'Batch size' (text rotated ~45°).

Three thin-bordered rectangular text boxes on white: (1) 'Group Normalization' bold red / '(Group of Channels)' bold blue / 'General Case' bold green; (2) 'Instance Normalization' bold red / 'Calculate (then Normalize) μ, σ for ONE Channel in ONE Sample (Output of ONE Filter)' black with 'μ, σ' red and 'ONE Channel', 'ONE Sample', '(Output of ONE Filter)' bold blue; (3) full-width 'Layer Normalization' bold red / 'Calculate (then Normalize) μ, σ for ALL Channels in the Same Sample (Input to Same Layer)' black with 'μ, σ' red, 'ALL Channels' and 'Same Sample' bold blue, '(Input to Same Layer)' bold green underlined.
Callout oval: solid black filled ellipse with bold yellow text 'Transformer choice', overlapping the right end of the Layer Normalization box.
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with red outline containing black text '44', at the right end of the gray title bar.

imagery: No photographs or clip-art; all graphics are vector-style isometric voxel-block (3D cube grid) illustrations in saturated flat colors with darker edge shading.
A small white mouse-pointer cursor icon overlays the front face of the left salmon cube (live-recording artifact).
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout (Arial-like). Slide title: bold, ~32-36pt, red, centered on gray bar, with an unusual space before the comma in 'Layer ,' (verbatim from source — do not correct). Header: bold italic, ~22-24pt, blue, title-case, wrapped on two lines. Text-box headings: bold ~16pt red; body ~14pt black sentence case with bold blue and bold green emphasis phrases; μ, σ symbols in red; '(Input to Same Layer)' bold green and underlined. Diagram labels: bold ~10-12pt black; exactly three labels are rotated to match their arrow direction — 'Samples' (along its diagonal arrow), 'Feature Vector' (90°, reading upward), 'Batch size' (~45°) — while both 'Channels' labels remain horizontal. 'Transformer choice' is bold yellow on a black oval. Slide number plain black in a yellow badge. No numbered or bulleted lists — content is in bordered text boxes.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built (no mid-build reveal). A live mouse cursor is visible on the left cube's front face. A thin black strip runs along the very bottom edge of the frame — likely video letterboxing, not slide content; exclude it when recreating the slide.
recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to plain white (#FFFFFF).
2. Draw the outer frame: a thin (~3pt) red (#CC0000) rectangle outline inset slightly from all four slide edges.
3. Draw the title bar: a full-width light-gray (#E0E0E0) rectangle across the top, occupying ~3-13% of slide height.
4. Place the title on the bar: bold red (#CC0000) sans-serif ~32-36pt text 'Layer , Group, and Instance Normalization', centered horizontally (keep the space before the comma).
5. Place the slide-number badge at the title bar's right end (~89-93% x, ~9-16% y): a yellow (#FFFF00) circle with a red (#CC0000) outline containing black text '44'.
6. Place the header top-left (~5-28% x, ~17-30% y): blue (#0000CC) bold italic ~22-24pt text on two lines: 'Sample Based' / 'Normalization'.
7. Build the input tensor cube at far left (~4-30% x, ~30-82% y): an isometric voxel block; front face = ~4-column x 5-row grid of salmon (#F07060) cells; top face = receding banded rows green (#40C040), yellow (#E8E040), orange (#E08030); right side face = vertical strips yellow (#E8E040), orange (#E08030), blue-gray (#7090B0).
8. On cube (7), add a red (#CC0000) double-headed diagonal arrow along the upper-left depth edge with bold black label 'Samples' rotated to follow the arrow.
9. Beneath cube (7)'s front face, add a red (#CC0000) double-headed horizontal arrow with bold black label 'Channels' (horizontal text).
10. Build the Group Normalization cube center-left (~28-50% x, ~15-65% y): isometric voxel block; front face = left ~three-quarters magenta (#CC44CC) cells and right ~quarter orange/salmon (#F07060) cells; top face = banded rows dark navy (#3050A0) at back, then green (#40C040), yellow (#E8E040), orange (#E08030) at front; right side face = vertical strips yellow, orange, blue-gray (#7090B0). No arrows or labels on this cube.
11. Build the Instance Normalization cube center-right (~46-68% x, ~20-68% y): isometric voxel block; front face = magenta (#CC44CC) cells with a single orange (#E08030) column at the right edge; top face = banded rows dark navy (#3050A0), green, yellow, orange; right side face = yellow/orange strips.
12. Build the dimension-labeled tensor at far right (~66-95% x, ~15-70% y): isometric voxel block; front face = ~4x5 grid of magenta (#CC44CC) cells; top face = banded rows green (#40C040), yellow (#E8E040), orange (#E08030); right side face = vertical strips yellow, orange, blue-gray (#7090B0).
13. Draw a thin red (#FF0000) rectangle with no fill tightly around cube (12).
14. At cube (12)'s left side, add a red (#FF0000) double-headed vertical arrow labeled 'Feature Vector' (bold black, rotated 90°, reading upward).
15. Beneath cube (12)'s front face, add a red (#FF0000) double-headed horizontal arrow labeled 'Channels' (bold black, horizontal).
16. Along cube (12)'s right depth edge, add a red (#FF0000) double-headed diagonal arrow labeled 'Batch size' (bold black, rotated ~45°).
17. Add the Group Normalization text box at bottom center-left (~27-46% x, ~68-82% y): white (#FFFFFF) fill, thin black border, three lines — 'Group Normalization' bold red (#CC0000) ~16pt; '(Group of Channels)' bold blue (#0000CC); 'General Case' bold green (#008000).
18. Add the Instance Normalization text box at bottom center-right (~47-90% x, ~68-82% y): white fill, thin black border — title 'Instance Normalization' bold red (#CC0000) ~16pt; body 'Calculate (then Normalize) μ, σ for ONE Channel in ONE Sample (Output of ONE Filter)' black (#000000) ~14pt with 'μ, σ' in red and 'ONE Channel', 'ONE Sample', '(Output of ONE Filter)' in bold blue (#0000CC).
19. Add the Layer Normalization text box along the bottom, full width (~6-95% x, ~83-96% y): white fill, thin black border — title 'Layer Normalization' bold red (#CC0000) ~16pt; body 'Calculate (then Normalize) μ, σ for ALL Channels in the Same Sample (Input to Same Layer)' black ~14pt with 'μ, σ' red, 'ALL Channels' and 'Same Sample' bold blue (#0000CC), and '(Input to Same Layer)' bold green (#008000) and underlined.
20. Add the callout oval at bottom-right (~76-93% x, ~84-92% y): a solid black (#000000) filled ellipse with bold yellow (#FFFF00) text 'Transformer choice', overlapping the right end of the Layer Normalization box (19).
21. Optional fidelity step: place a small white mouse-cursor arrow icon on the front face of cube (7) (~11% x, ~55% y) — this is a live-recording artifact. Do NOT add the thin black strip at the very bottom edge of the slide; it is video letterboxing, not slide content.
